title: SSH Key Input
description: Stops a private key being pasted where a public key belongs by saying so loudly, telling the user to rotate it and pulling out the public half in one tap, and catches DSA and short RSA keys, keys wrapped across lines or cut off, a missing or wrong type prefix, the SSH2 export format and a key already on the account, showing the SHA256 fingerprint and comment exactly as ssh-keygen prints them.
mistakes: pasted private key instead of public
